authors: Marcus Oel, Arne Roeder, Ina Meyer, Roland Lachmayer
name: luh-design-tool-for-topology-and-particle-damping-optimization-of-additively-manufactured-parts
notes:
The tool provided here can be used to optimize the topology of additively manufactured components in terms of weight reduction while integrating particle damping.

The basic functionality of the optimization and the effect of particle damping are described in the accompanying publication:
https://doi.org/10.1017/pds.2025.10142

The optimization can be carried out in Abaqus. Abaqus is controlled by the scripts listed below.
This repository entry contains the following files:

* “TopologyAndParticleDampingOptimization.py”: Abaqus script for topology optimization and integration of particle damping

* “TopologyOptimization.py”: Abaqus script for pure topology optimization

* “AbaqusMacroForSTLExport.py”: Abaqus script for automated export of individual functional areas (solid, PD, void) from Abaqus as STL

* “AbaqusMacroForVisualization.py”: Abaqus script for visualization of optimization results


__Acknowledgements__

The project ”Development methodology for laser powder bed fused lightweight structures with integrated particle dampers for vibration reduction” was funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) - Project number 495193504
